channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian strikes kill 6 people in Ukraine, day after shopping complex attack
item.description: Meanwhile, Ukrainian drone hits home in southern Russia, killing two children and injuring their parents, officials say.

item.title: Former world champion boxer Zolani Tete shot and killed in South Africa
item.description: Zolani Tete, who held WBF flyweight and WBO bantamweight world titles, killed at his home in Eastern Cape, South Africa.

item.title: Iran says new US sanctions violate sovereignty of other states
item.description: Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei slams Trump's latest threat as a return to 'full-scale classic colonialism'.

item.title: Palestinian teen shot and killed in West Bank attack, UN responds
item.description: A 17-year-old Palestinian was killed and another person critically injured in a settler attack in the occupied West Bank

item.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
item.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

item.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
item.description: Four people are still missing after Friday's attack which killed 16 and left 130 injured, including a number of children.

item.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
item.description: Officials say another three people were injured, and an 18-year-old male suspect shot and arrested.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy suffering 'command hallucination' when she killed children, court hears
item.description: The defence brought their final witness - a forensic psychiatrist - to the stand to testify about the effects of postpartum psychosis.

item.title: UK, Canada and Australia condemn Israel for refusing criminal probe into aid worker killings in Gaza
item.description: Seven World Central Kitchen workers were killed in the Israeli strike on their convoy in 2024.

item.title: Ebola vaccine trial to start in DR Congo as warning issued over speed of infections
item.description: About half of the 2,500 recorded deaths from Ebola happened in the last 20 days, the WHO says.
